Admissions
Start your journey with the J. Crayton Pruitt Family Department of Biomedical Engineering. Whether you’re a first-year student, a transfer applicant, or pursuing an advanced degree, UF BME offers a supportive and collaborative environment designed to help you succeed.
Explore Admissions Options
Undergraduate Learn how to apply as a first-year student to our nationally ranked Biomedical Engineering program.
TransferExplore the process for students transferring from another institution or a different major within UF.
GraduateTake your education to the next level with our Master’s and Doctoral programs in Biomedical Engineering.
Discover what it’s like to be part of the Gator Engineering community!
